issue.title: Monitor whose supervisor dies after persisting a terminal monitor_state but before monitor_settled is never reconciled

task_type_fields.impact: The lane's workspace claim and follow-up are never settled (no follow-up launch or recorded disposition), %wait / sase monitor show --follow keep waiting on a monitor that will never settle, and the Agents tab can only show the command's own Failed bucket. The TUI fix for the clan FAILED flicker deliberately keeps this case reading Failed (liveness-guarded settling) so it still surfaces.
task_type_fields.repro: finish_monitor persists agent_meta.json with a terminal monitor_state (and stopped_at popped) before settle_claim_and_followup_under_lane_lock and wait_for_followup_started; only afterwards does it write monitor_settled: true, stopped_at, and done.json. should_reconcile_dead_supervisor returns False for any monitor_state other than 'running', and no other monitor path (store_lane, reconcile, _proc_adapter_followup) recovers a terminal-but-unsettled record. Repro: start a monitor whose command fails, SIGKILL the supervisor after the terminal meta write but before monitor_settled (e.g. during the follow-up launch / wait_for_followup_started window), then run any store_lane read that reconciles: the record stays terminal, unsettled, without done.json or a follow-up disposition.

issue.creation_reason: Confirmed by reading while fixing the clan FAILED flicker: the settle window between finish_monitor's first meta write and monitor_settled has no dead-supervisor recovery, so a crash there strands the lane and its follow-up.

payload.description: Same should_reconcile_dead_supervisor predicate; a fix for either reconcile gap could collide with the other
